public_definitions: Review the Store B monthly sales dashboard for April through June, then choose the June route in the monthly bonus operations form.
Use the Store B sales dashboard as the evidence source for the June sales route.
June sales route: Route June to above-average sales bonus response, Route June to low-sales response, Keep June on normal sales monitoring.
